title: Notice Regarding Potential Quality Issues and Establishment of an Investigation Committee Composed of External Experts
excerpt: Potential issues were identified at multiple production sites, and their financial impact remained under investigation.
summary: Nidec disclosed group-wide potential quality issues, including changes to materials, processes and designs without customer approval, improper handling of testing and inspection data, and origin-labeling issues. The company said no immediate product-functionality or safety impact had been identified, but the inspection was ongoing, affected customers were being contacted, the financial impact was undetermined, and an external-expert committee expected to complete its work by the end of August 2026.
